{{Quote|Qui-Gon? What's this about me saving your life last year?''"<br />"''Remember the official banquet for the Hewett senators? You stopped me before I took a bite of Konkeel pie.|Adi Gallia and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="EIA4" />}}
'''Konkeel pie''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made and [[Diet/Legends|consumed]] by the [[Hewett]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was highly toxic to [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], known for even being [[Death/Legends|fatal]] at times.<ref name="EIA4" /> At some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]'' takes place prior to {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> while at a banquet hosted by Hewett [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] nearly took a bite of the pie before fellow Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] stopped him. The Hewett senators took the pie off their menu, apologizing to their humanoid guests. Around a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later, Jinn recounted the story of Gallia saving his life to his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], though he left out the details, forcing Kenobi to ask Gallia for further explanation of the Konkeel pie tale himself.<ref name="EIA4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Konkeel pie was mentioned in [[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency|''Jedi Emergency'']], the fourth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' series, which was authored by [[Ryder Windham]] and published in [[1999]].<ref name="EIA4" />
